data.one_liner: Audio support wrapper for the Flame game engine
data.what_it_does: Provides audio capabilities for Flame games using audioplayers underneath. Allows playing general sound effects, looping background music, caching tracks, and managing audio pools.
use_when: You are building a game with the Flame engine and need sound effects or background music
You want a thin audio wrapper optimized for Flame game integration
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine
You need a complex standalone music player UI outside of a game context
strengths: Seamless integration with Flame game code
Supports caching tracks and high-frequency audio pools for rapid sound effects
weaknesses: Thin wrapper; advanced audio manipulation depends entirely on audioplayers
Requires specific asset directory configuration in pubspec.yaml
data.setup_notes: Add audio files to assets/audio and configure assets in pubspec.yaml.
